protocol.scope: Owner-approved independent synthetic diagnosis; no benchmark replay or runtime patch

metric_semantics.queue_meta: Response meta.queue_ms is time before submission, NOT scheduler queue wait.
metric_semantics.compute_meta: Response meta.compute_ms is submission-to-result time, including scheduler queue.
metric_semantics.prometheus_queue: vllm_srun_queue_duration_seconds observes job enqueue to first scheduled batch.
metric_semantics.prometheus_forward: Scheduler batch wall time including readout; not necessarily one backbone call.
metric_semantics.gpu: One-second samples over each pool, not a kernel utilization or saturation proof.
